routes.name: Thought Bubble Versus Real Face
routes.visual_engine: Her inner forgiveness is visible in thought bubbles while her face/body tells the opposite truth.

routes.name: Doorway Blast Cut
routes.visual_engine: The whole deck builds to the moment he appears at the kitchen door and the room changes.

routes.name: Rage Cleaning Tempo
routes.visual_engine: Each chore gets louder while she convinces herself she is calm.

routes.name: Pressure Cooker Timing
routes.visual_engine: The cooker whistle and door sound become the comic trigger.

routes.name: Second Entrance Ritual
routes.visual_engine: He visually considers stepping out and re-entering after her reaction.

selector_note: Use Thought Bubble Versus Real Face with Doorway Blast Cut. Reject clever line-led endings.
